newsitem.title: UK: Sheffield United leaps as trading resumes.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield United leaps as trading resumes.

text.p: Sheffield United Plc made its official debut on the UK stock market on Thursday, with the soccer club's share price running up to a substantial premium to the price of a placing announced last month.

Joining a growing band of UK soccer clubs with a stock market quote, shares in United -- which is pushing for promotion to the Premier League -- were trading 102-1/2 by 1427 GMT, up sharply on the 60p placing price.

The relisting comes after a reverse takeover by leisurewear company Conrad Plc, whose shares were suspended in December when the company announced plans to buy the club, funding the move through a placing and open offer.
At an extraordinary meeting on Tuesday shareholders approved the offer for the club and Conrad's change of name to Sheffield United Plc.
A company spokesman said the current price level gave the club a market capitalisation of just shy of 50 million stg.
